AnswerSection.description: A user-facing answer part, kept alongside the legacy one-string answer.
AnswerSection.title: AnswerSection

CaseClosureRequest.description: A reviewer-owned closure decision; it never sends anything anywhere.
CaseClosureRequest.title: CaseClosureRequest

ConfirmedExtractedTextCreate.description: Human-confirmed text may enter the existing text-review workflow.
ConfirmedExtractedTextCreate.title: ConfirmedExtractedTextCreate

CorrectionDraft.description: A non-binding assistant suggestion which a reviewer may copy into a proposal.
CorrectionDraft.title: CorrectionDraft

DevelopmentSessionRequest.description: Explicit local identity selection; the endpoint is loopback-only.
DevelopmentSessionRequest.title: DevelopmentSessionRequest

DocumentAssetView.description: Safe Browser projection; object keys and source hashes stay internal.
DocumentAssetView.title: DocumentAssetView

FindingDecisionRecord.description: Current finding decision plus every prior reviewer decision.
FindingDecisionRecord.title: FindingDecisionRecord

FindingDecisionRequest.description: A reviewer-owned decision which never changes the Agent result.
FindingDecisionRequest.title: FindingDecisionRequest

GuidanceResolution.description:
Safe, public snapshot-resolution metadata for one guidance attempt.

This contains only a fixed topic/scope projection, date, direction, and
coverage state.  Registry hash and source-internal identifiers never
appear here; Backend uses its packaged registry projection internally.
GuidanceResolution.title: GuidanceResolution

HsReferenceEntryView.description: One packaged HSK reference row for a manually typed 10-digit code.
HsReferenceEntryView.title: HsReferenceEntryView

HsReferenceSearchView.description: Packaged HSK reference rows matching a code prefix or an item name.
HsReferenceSearchView.title: HsReferenceSearchView

HsSelectionRecord.description: Current reviewer HS code selection plus every prior selection.
HsSelectionRecord.title: HsSelectionRecord

HsSelectionRequest.description: A reviewer-owned HS code confirmation which never changes the Agent result.
HsSelectionRequest.title: HsSelectionRequest

KnowledgeConversationCreate.description:
Create a standalone official-trade knowledge conversation.

It is intentionally not attached to a Case or a Review Run.  A case
conversation remains the only API that can receive immutable review facts
or create a correction draft.
KnowledgeConversationCreate.title: KnowledgeConversationCreate

ReviewProgressView.description: Display-only live progress; never part of the immutable review result.
ReviewProgressView.title: ReviewProgressView

ReviewRunSummary.description: Compact case-history projection; use the detail endpoint for facts.
ReviewRunSummary.title: ReviewRunSummary

TemporalContext.description:
Immutable Evidence snapshot dates supplied by the Agent.

The values are provenance only.  They do not decide whether an HSK or
requirement snapshot applies to a particular historical case; the Agent
has already validated that ``law_as_of`` is bound to the review date.
TemporalContext.title: TemporalContext

TemporalCoverage.description: Explicit Evidence availability for each independently dated source.
TemporalCoverage.title: TemporalCoverage

info.description: Local text-review API. Results always require human review.
info.title: Customs Review Workbench API
